name: Area at least 1 hectare
source_clause: Climate Change Response Act 2002, s 4 definition of forest land (a)
implementation: Compare unrounded area in EPSG:2193 with 10000 square metres

name: Average width at least 30 metres
source_clause: Climate Change Response Act 2002, s 4 definition of forest land (c); MPI average-width guidance
implementation: Use -15 m erosion as primary diagnostic and compare with 2A/P; neither is the legal centre-line method
failure_action: Quarantine erosion failures and all method disagreements for assessor measurement

name: Not mapped as pre-1990 forest land
source_clause: Climate Change Response Act 2002, s 4 definition of pre-1990 forest land
implementation: Calculate true intersection area with supplied LUCAS 1989/2007 planted-forest evidence
failure_action: Quarantine overlap greater than 1 square metre and require manual land-history review for all others

name: Not within supplied public conservation land
source_clause: Project triage policy; ownership and registered rights still require authoritative evidence
implementation: Calculate true intersection area with DOC public-conservation polygons
failure_action: Exclude overlap greater than 1 square metre from this planting-opportunity triage only

name: Current land-cover proxy is potentially plantable
source_clause: Project proxy based on LCDB class; not an ETS eligibility rule

name: Species qualifies as forest species
source_clause: Climate Change Response Act 2002, s 4 definition of forest species

name: Crown cover more than 30 percent in each hectare
source_clause: Climate Change Response Act 2002, s 4 definition of forest land (a)
failure_action: Manual evidence and imagery review required

name: Species capable of reaching 5 metres at maturity
source_clause: Climate Change Response Act 2002, s 4 definition of forest species
failure_action: Manual species and site evidence required
